headline: Central Front Shifts Colonials Consolidate Core
war_summary: Since the 03:01 edition the central corridor has edged further toward the Colonials. In Dead Lands the Warden advantage has narrowed from an 8‑3 lead to a 6‑5 split, while Drowned Vale (11‑1), Farranac Coast (9‑2) and Endless Shore (9‑1) remain firmly Colonial. Clahstra has fallen completely to Colonial control, Linn Mercy stays an all‑Warden bastion, and Kingscage continues to lean Colonial seven to one; the Fingers stay contested three to four. The peripheral arcs are unchanged: Colonials hold the western‑southern belt from Acrithia through Umbral Wildwood, and Wardens retain the northern‑eastern stretch from Basin Sionnach to the Weathered Expanse. Base turnover in the past day was heaviest on Endless Shore (42 changes), Drowned Vale (29), Farranac Coast (18), Dead Lands (14), Palantine Berm (14) and Linn Mercy (13). Casualty rates have accelerated in the most recent hour on all four hot fronts — colonial and Warden losses both rising on Drowned Vale, Farranac Coast and Endless Shore, while Dead Lands sees colonial losses accelerating and Warden losses cooling. Enlistments show a mixed picture: steady in Dead Lands and Farranac Coast, but accelerating in Drowned Vale and Endless Shore, signalling fresh reinforcements arriving at the busiest sectors.
